name: shared-automations
description: Serve trigger rows from a shared automations file — a synced folder, an NFS share, a checked-out team repo. Everyone pointed at the file sees the same automations on their Automations page, and each machine arms and fires ONLY the rows attributed to its own owner: everybody else's render read-only and structurally cannot arm. No server and no credentials; the file holds trigger definitions only, and your harness does all the firing under all of its own gates.
author: PersonalClaw

x-meta.label: Shared automations file
x-meta.help: Absolute path to the shared JSON file holding the team's trigger rows (e.g. ~/synced/team/automations.json). Supports ~ and $VARS. Leave empty to configure later — the store serves no rows until it is set.
